summary: #smallpoems Life unwinds from a dias cast in twine spinning tales of freedom. Portunos holds rapture while hot keys of fire tossed at desire dance in vices and pleading devices Sagan sung, we all made of stars these sermons paint our prison walls in hues of amber fits and blues
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems

Life unwinds
from a dias
cast in twine
spinning tales
of
freedom.
Portunos
holds rapture
while hot keys
of fire tossed
at
desire
dance in vices
and pleading
devices
Sagan
sung, we all made
of stars
these
sermons paint
  our prison walls
in hues of amber fits
and blues
